name: Adam Lewandowski
bio:
Adam's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by watching Polish rally legends compete on challenging terrains. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, and quickly found his niche in racing. His career started with smaller racing outfits, where he honed his skills in vehicle setup and data analysis. Adam's approach to technical directorship is rooted in meticulous planning and constant refinement. He firmly believes that success in motorsport relies on the synergy between driver feedback and precise technical adjustments, always striving for the perfect balance. His dedication and knack for problem-solving make him a valuable asset to any team.

After several successful seasons in national racing series, Adam joined EVO Racing Team, eager to take on new challenges and apply his expertise to a more competitive environment. He is known for his ability to quickly identify and address technical issues, ensuring that the team's vehicles are always performing at their peak. Adam is constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve performance, driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what is possible. He sees his role not just as a job, but as a passion, constantly learning and adapting to the ever-evolving world of motorsport technology.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Adam is a man of average height with a focused gaze and a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical schematics and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating all sensors himself before a race.
